verdict.rationale: Foreloop collects incoming user reports through its feedback widget, and once a person turns a report into an intention, an agent reads the submission, fills in the intention and proposes tasks. That is a limited form of AI-assisted triage. The first triage step, deciding whether a submission is real or spam, is framed as a manual decision. The P0/P1/P2 ratings apply to pull request reviews, not incoming issues, so they do not count here. missing for 10: automatic severity suggestion for incoming issues, routing or assignment to the right owner, fully automatic triage without a manual real-vs-spam step, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have incoming issues automatically triaged with severity suggested and routed to the right owner

citations.quote: An intention starts from the report, and its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes the tasks
